title: Sketch map of Guam showing "Guam Holding Pattern" and balloon launch site
description: Hand-drawn sketch map at the bottom of page 3 of an Air Intelligence Information Report (IR-7-57), showing the outline of Guam on a grid from 144°30' to 145°E and 13°10' to 13°40'N. Hand-lettered labels mark the "GUAM HOLDING PATTERN" as a looped track near the north of the island, "BALLOON LAUNCHED HERE" near Agana, and "ANDERSON AFB." The text above explains that a lighted weather balloon had been launched from the U.S. Navy Communications Station on 31 Dec 56, but the observing F-86D pilot did not believe the UFOB was a balloon because it maneuvered and accelerated past his aircraft.
